straggle.definition: n. a wandering or disorderly grouping (of things or persons)
straggle.translation:
vi. 掉队, 落伍, 蔓延, 散乱
n. 低空扫射

straggled.translation: v. 蔓延( straggle的过去式和过去分词 ); 散漫; 落伍; 落后

straggler.definition: n. someone who strays or falls behind
straggler.translation: n. 游荡者, 朱经请假擅离船舰的人员, 掉队者

stragglers.definition: n. someone who strays or falls behind
stragglers.translation: n. 流浪者；落伍的士兵；离群的动物；[植] 蔓生的枝叶

straggles.definition:
n a wandering or disorderly grouping (of things or persons)
v wander from a direct or straight course
v go, come, or spread in a rambling or irregular way
straggles.translation: v. 蔓延( straggle的第三人称单数 ); 散漫; 落伍; 落后

stragglier.translation: a. 散乱的；蔓延的；零乱四散的；七零八落的 (straggly的变形)

straggliest.translation: a. 散乱的；蔓延的；零乱四散的；七零八落的 (straggly的变形)

straggling.definition:
v wander from a direct or straight course
v go, come, or spread in a rambling or irregular way
s spreading out in different directions

stragglingly.translation: adv. 脱离队伍地, 落后地

straggly.definition: s. growing or spreading sparsely or irregularly
straggly.translation: a. 蔓延的, 散落的, 散乱的

stragulum.definition: n. The mantle, or pallium, of a bird.
stragulum.translation: n. 鸟背及收缩的两翼
